Subject: POC: evaluation path selection & ownership — HarborTech

Hi Ana — thanks again for the call today. Quick recap and a proposed path to get the POC running with clear success criteria and owners. Please confirm or flag anything missing.

Summary of discovery (short):
- Goal: Improve customer intent routing and reduce manual triage for live support messages.
- Expected volume for POC: ~12k messages/day from two regions; subset of traffic ok for shadowing.
- Data sensitivity: PII redaction required; HarborTech prefers minimal token sharing.

Proposed POC structure (two-stage, recommended offline-first):
1) Offline evaluation (2 weeks) — Redwood ingests a redacted batch sample, runs models, and scores outputs against your gold labels using a shared rubric. Pros: no live traffic, faster compliance review. Cons: may miss real-time behavior.
2) Limited online shadow (1 week) — Mirror ~5-10% of production requests to Redwood in read-only mode to measure latency, KB hits, and live distribution drift. Pros: realistic metrics; Cons: needs safe routing and quick failbacks.

Success criteria (proposed):
- Functional: intent classification F1 >= 0.92 on gold set (offline).
- Latency: 95th percentile generation latency < 600ms in-region during shadow.
- Reliability: 99.5% of shadow requests return within SLA window (no user-visible errors).
- Cost target: incremental inference cost < $0.03 per 1k tokens for the shadow configuration.

Owners / immediate assignments:
- Redwood: Soojin (overall POC lead, SOW & kickoff), Rishi (infra/provisioning & secure routing), Marissa (evaluation rubric + analysis).
- HarborTech: Ana (product lead), Procurement (contract & SOW approval), Engineering (data sample & access).

Attachments: HarborTech_POC_SOW_draft.pdf; evaluation_rubric_v1.xlsx; infra_access_checklist.txt

Decision request / next steps: please confirm by EOD Monday whether HarborTech prefers (A) offline-first as above or (B) start with a short shadow-only run. Also note procurement windows / any required security docs (SOC2, encryption-at-rest). If offline-first is OK we will target these milestones:
- Deliverable: redacted sample spec + rubric agreed — by 2026-11-27
- Offline run & scoring — 2026-11-30 to 2026-12-11
- Shadow window (if approved) — 2026-12-14 to 2026-12-18

Thanks — I’ll standby to coordinate procurement and engineering kickoff.

--

Agree with the owners as listed. Please send a SOW (PDF) to procurement and cc me. Once procurement has a draft they will follow the usual redline process.
